arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-serial-audit.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/project"
test "$(git -C "$tmp/project" rev-parse HEAD)" = 3ecdcd79573104c39ed644dbfd1bd57596e51d06
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$tmp/host-validator"
chmod 700 "$tmp/host-validator"
cd "$tmp/project"
python3 - "$tmp/host-validator" "$tmp/project" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from codex.dual import trusted_phase_one_validator
import sys
cb=trusted_phase_one_validator(Path(sys.argv[1]),Path(sys.argv[2]),20)
assert callable(cb)
print("SERIAL_SANDBOX_PREFLIGHT=PASS_NO_MODEL",flush=True)
PY
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd "$tmp"
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/vps"
echo 'SUPERVISOR_SOURCE_REFERENCE'
grep -R -n -E 'NO_CHANGE|FORWARDED|COUNT=|dedup|notifi|telegram|cursor|poll|event' "$tmp/vps/ops/supervisor_cloud_source.py" "$tmp/vps/ops/supervisor_live.py" "$tmp/vps/ops/telegram_gateway.py" | sed -n '1,85p'
echo 'SUPERVISOR_WORKFLOW_REFERENCE'
find "$tmp/vps/.github/workflows" -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*supervisor*' -print
echo 'SERIAL_AND_OBSERVER_AUDIT_DONE'
